findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cao_generer_dxf, cao_pdf, cao_video, bonnes_pratiques · Private data: quittance_loyer, cao_video, cao_verifier, bonnes_pratiques, decide_campagne, avenant_revision_irl, avis_echeance, relance_impaye, crg_proprietaire, fiscal_synthese, mouvement_locataire, edl_etat_des_lieux, bon_intervention, facture_facturx, mandat_gerance, candidature_locataire, pack_partenaire, fiche_mission, devis_travaux, liste_materiaux, confirmation_rdv, note_frais, journal_kilometrique, compte_rendu_chantier, relance_facture_client, conformite_artisan · Public sink: quittance_loyer, cao_video, cao_verifier, decide_campagne, obtenir_cle_api, avis_echeance, relance_impaye, crg_proprietaire, fiscal_synthese, mouvement_locataire, edl_etat_des_lieux, bon_intervention, facture_facturx, declaration_paiement, mandat_gerance, annonce_location, fiche_mission, devis_travaux, liste_materiaux, confirmation_rdv, note_frais, journal_kilometrique, compte_rendu_chantier, relance_facture_client, conformite_artisan · Destructive: cao_video, fiscal_synthese, facture_facturx.
